item.text:
**Bottom line:** Mixed, leaning negative. AMLO did show some anti-privilege behavior in 2024, especially aggressive tax enforcement against a politically connected billionaire and repeated anti-corruption rhetoric. But the stronger 2024 record is institutional weakening: blocked transparency appointments, judicial restructuring, and other moves that reduced the checks needed to resist corruption and oligarchic capture.

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15 | The government publicly pursued a major tax-evasion case against Totalplay, a Grupo Salinas company, after the Supreme Court agreed the firm had used improper deductions. This is direct evidence of resisting tax privileges for a politically connected business. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.1`

- [Poder Judicial detuvo casos de defraudación fiscal; presidente exhibe actos de corrupción](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/poder-judicial-detuvo-casos-de-defraudacion-fiscal-presidente-exhibe-actos-de-corrupcion/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-18 | AMLO highlighted 13 tax-fraud cases that allegedly cost the treasury more than 129 billion pesos and pressed the judiciary to resolve them. That is positive evidence for anti-corruption enforcement, though it is also framed as a complaint against courts rather than a clean institutional reform. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.1`

- [09.05.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/09-05-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-05-09 | AMLO said corruption was the central problem to eliminate and argued Mexico could advance without it. This is direct anti-corruption rhetoric and a claim of anti-privilege intent, but it is still rhetorical rather than proof of a broader structural cleanup. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`

- [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW said AMLO and his party blocked appointments to INAI, leaving the transparency/data-protection body unable to function normally. Weakening the main access-to-information watchdog cuts against resisting corruption and capture. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `4B.9`

- [Mexico proposed constitutional changes threaten rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | HRW warned the reforms would weaken judicial independence and abolish the independent privacy/transparency watchdog, making anti-corruption and anti-capture oversight weaker. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `4B.9`

- [Analysis-Mexico investors worry lopsided vote could threaten rule of law](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/analysismexico-investors-worry-lopsided-vote-could-threaten-rule-of-law-3475796) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-07 | Reuters reported investor concern that AMLO might use his post-election mandate to sweep aside checks on presidential power. That is indirect but real negative evidence for oligarchic capture resistance. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `5B.3`

- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15 | Reuters said the overhaul weakened judicial independence and worried investors. Weak courts make corruption, favoritism, and connected-business privileges harder to check. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `5B.3`

- [The government used insecurity to justify expanding state surveillance with little accountability](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House said the government expanded surveillance with little oversight and that a covert military cyberspace unit monitored critics. While not a corruption case per se, it supports a broader pattern of weak accountability and state capture risk. IDs: `5B.5`, `4B.9`, `4B.10`

**Search gap:** I found direct 2024 evidence for tax enforcement against a connected business and against fiscal fraud, but little direct evidence of broad anti-monopoly or pro-competition enforcement. The negative evidence is stronger on weakening oversight institutions than on explicit bribery or quid-pro-quo favoritism.
